Hi Olivia — great to hear the demo landed well. Short answers up front, details below so your procurement/finance folks have what they need:

- Yes, we can do an invoice-first flow: you can issue a PO up front and we invoice monthly/at-trial-end for actual consumption.
- We can also accept prepayment credits and, if unused at trial end, apply remaining balance as a credit against the final invoice ("fallthrough credit").

Tradeoffs:
- PO/invoice path = simpler for accounting but we need a billing commitment window (30 days after trial close) to lock rates.
- Prepay credits give you predictable spending caps during the eval and are easiest for rate guarantees; fallthrough credits are mechanically applied as described but require the final reconciliation step.

I'll loop in Ben from Sales Ops to confirm the exact SOW/invoice templates and Karthik from Finance to confirm how we handle credits operationally. Also attaching our standard short ops checklist for Private deployments so your infra lead can start.

Next steps I propose:
1) You tell us PO vs prepay by Wed (10/21).
2) If PO: we email a draft invoice schedule + SOW and Marcus@Redwood will sign the commercial header for trial access.
3) If Prepay: Ben will issue a credit invoice and we'll hold the surrender tokens against the trial.

Thanks — talk soon.

Hi all — quick operations + billing summary and attached examples.

Options (short):
1) PO -> Post-trial invoicing (Preferred for BrightArc Finance)
   - Customer sends PO at trial start listing estimated max not-to-exceed amount.
   - Redwood invoices at trial close for actual consumption; if actual > PO estimate we invoice the delta and map to PO number.
   - Timing: Redwood needs final consumption numbers within 7 business days after trial close to produce the invoice.

2) Prepay credits -> Fallthrough credit application
   - Customer prepays for blocks (example: $10k block). At trial close, unused balance auto-applies as a credit to next invoice or refund per contract (default: credit).
   - If a refund is requested, our finance team initiates a refund request; this may take 7–10 business days.

Operational notes:
- For PO path we attach a short SOW (see RI-SOW-v1.docx) that defines the evaluation services and connectivity milestones.
- For prepay path we require an invoice reference and a reconciliation sheet.
- Connectivity checklist (attached PDF) documents IP allowlists, service account steps, and expected engineering lead time (2–4 business days).

Attached: example invoice schedule (invoice-examples.xlsx), draft SOW (RI-SOW-v1.docx).

If BrightArc prefers PO, send PO + company billing contact and we'll prep an invoice schedule and a trial acceptance form to sign. If prepay, tell us desired block size and we'll issue a credit invoice immediately.
